name: guard
description: guard: redacts secrets from your prompts and tool output, warns you when you paste one, asks before a secret is written to a file or run in a command. Optional extra security (Presidio) adds email, phone, card, Aadhaar, PAN and more, enabled from /guard setup. /guard shows what was caught.

mode.title: When a secret is in your prompt
mode.description: redact: replace it before sending and warn you. warn: send as typed but warn you.

scanEnv.title: Learn secrets from the repo's .env files
scanEnv.description: Values found in .env files are caught anywhere they appear.

guardActions.title: Ask before a secret is written to a file or run in a command
guardActions.description: Applies to Write, Edit and Bash. Writes to .env files are always allowed.

extraNames.title: Extra security: also detect names and places
extraNames.description: Noisier: may flag product and company names. Only applies when extra security is on.

extraMinScore.title: Extra security: minimum confidence (0 to 1)
extraMinScore.description: Lower catches more and flags more false alarms.
